competences.description: Attacks the enemy and creates a shield equal to 10% of your MAX HP on the ally with the lowest HP status for 2 turns. In addition, Sapsaree attacks the enemy and stuns for 1 turn with a 50% chance if you gain a turn while under inability effects.

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
effets.note: 10% on ally with the lowest HP status

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
effets.note: If you gain a turn while under inability effects

competences.description: Recovers the HP of all allies by 15% for 2 turns and grants immunity for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's HP will be recovered by 15% on each turn.
The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.

competences.description: Recovers the HP of all allies by 10% at the start of your turn. The HP of allies granted with beneficial effects is recovered additionally by 10%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.note: every beneficial effect granted on each ally at the start of your turn
